hooks.command: $j = ($input -join '') | ConvertFrom-Json; $f = $j.tool_input.file_path; if ($f -and $f -match 'requirements\.txt$') { $root = 'C:\Users\psych\OneDrive\Documents\GitHub\bixdot'; $result = pip-audit -r "$root\requirements.txt" 2>&1 | Out-String; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { $out = @{hookSpecificOutput = @{hookEventName = 'PostToolUse'; additionalContext = "pip-audit found vulnerabilities:`n$result"}} | ConvertTo-Json -Compress; Write-Output $out } }
